content:
Maria: quick note — spinning up OdysseyPro-v2 q4 bringup on staging, running our multilocale smoke suite (en->zh/ja/ko/ar/he).
Satoshi: nice, any regressions so far? :eyes:
Maria: overall perf looks ok, but zh/ja vertical samples show strange token merges and extra punctuation in outputs. small sample below.
Li-Wei: can you paste the input/output?
Maria: sure:
```
# input (vertical subtitle style)
「今日は
いい天気ですね。」
# model output (odysseypro-v2 q4)
「今天
不错 。」。
```
Maria: notice the extra fullwidth period and a dangling ASCII punctuation on next line.
Kevin: that feels like a detokenization issue where line-break-aware normalization is losing grapheme boundaries.
Ana: also saw Hebrew RTL bracket flips when mixed with CJK numerals in same string.
Satoshi: did this happen only with q4 or with float32 too?
Maria: float32 baseline is clean on same test. so likely quant path/kernel selection.
Kai: pinging eval-bot to run locale diffs across latest canaries. @eval-bot run locale-diff odysseypro-v2 q4 -> report brief
eval-bot: acknowledged. queueing job 2995007901. will post summary when done.
Kevin: while we wait, can someone run a quick tokenization compare (baseline vs q4) for that sample? maybe token id alignment shift.
Li-Wei: doing that now, will dump token ids and detok.
Maria: thanks. if token ids match but detok differs, maybe demerge rules differ in kernel.
Satoshi: add check: KV-cache offset/seqlen changes can trick kvcache trimming into injecting stray control tokens.
Ana: also reproduce with different batch sizes — if batching path differs it may change kernel route.
Maria: good call. i'll test batch 1/8/32.
Kai: if repro quick, we should bisect to the quant kernel change set (last 2 weeks). prioritize before canary promote. :pray:
Maria: agreed. i'll update thread with token dumps and eval-bot summary.
Satoshi: thanks — looping in infra if we need kernel rollback.
